== Overview

Systematic renaming of systemd units and scripts to follow standardized conventions. This phase removes inconsistent suffixes and establishes clear, maintainable naming patterns.

== Objectives

* Rename all manifests services to remove `-install` suffix
* Rename all ready services to remove `-check` suffix
* Rename all readiness scripts to remove `-check` suffix
* Update all references across services, targets, scripts, and documentation
* Use `git mv` to preserve history
* Validate no dangling references remain

=== Naming Convention Established

.*Standard Patterns*
|===
| Component | Pattern | Example

| Manifests service
| `rke2lab-<layer>-manifests.service`
| `rke2lab-storage-manifests.service`

| Ready service
| `rke2lab-<layer>-ready.service`
| `rke2lab-storage-ready.service`

| Ready target
| `rke2lab-<layer>-ready.target`
| `rke2lab-storage-ready.target`

| Script (manifests)
| `rke2-apply-<layer>-manifests.sh`
| `rke2-apply-storage-manifests.sh`

| Script (ready)
| `rke2-<component>-ready.sh`
| `rke2-openebs-ready.sh`
|===

== Lessons Learned

=== Git Operations
* Use `git mv` (not plain `mv`) to preserve rename history
* Use `git rm -f` to forcibly remove staged files when needed
* Git detects renames automatically if content is similar enough

=== Reference Updates
* Provide sufficient context (3+ lines) in file replacements
* Check all file types: services, targets, scripts, docs
* Use grep searches to validate no stale references remain

=== Coordination
* Address user corrections promptly (`git mv` vs `mv`)
* Validate each layer before moving to next
* Keep activation scripts aligned with service changes
